## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior
- [ ] Nothing hardcoded: prompts, models, permissions and limits come from `defaults/` and the configuration
- [ ] New UI texts go through `tr()` and have a translation in `src/renderer/i18n-ru.ts`
- [ ] The matching page in `docs/` is updated, if users see or do something differently
